The brochure does not contain the full terms of the policy, including the complete list of exclusions, and directs readers to the Policy document for that information [1].

If the Insured commits suicide, whether sane or insane, within one year from the Policy Date, the insurer's total liability is limited to the aggregate of the Account Value on the date of death and the Cost of Insurance deducted, without any interest [2].

The Terminal Illness Benefit will not be paid for a Terminal Illness caused, directly or indirectly, by any disease or illness that occurred within 60 days after the Effective Date of Coverage or the approval date of reinstatement, whichever is later [2].
